title: Walking Tour - Seville
text:
We had the most wonderful walking tour of Seville with Beatriz!
It was our first visit to Seville, and we couldn’t have wished for a better introduction to one of the most beautiful cities I have ever visited.
Beatriz was an exceptional guide. Her knowledge of the city’s history, architecture and culture was extraordinary, and she shared it all with such warmth and enthusiasm. No question was too difficult, and she made the entire experience both fascinating and enjoyable.

We couldn’t recommend her more highly. Thank you, Beatriz, for such a memorable experience!
author: 570belindaef

title: Wonderful extensive walking tour
text: My family had the luck of having Clara as our guide on this extended walking tour. She was so knowledgeable of the rich history and spirit of Seville, it really helped make the sites come alive.  We were able to see many highlights (but come prepared with your walking shoes)!  Thank you Clara!
author: masaru f

title: Friendly, experienced, and knowledgeable guide. Great route.
text: Great experience on the route as well with our guide (Bea) through Seville.  Wonderful route from Isabel Bridge, through City Center, the Cathedral, Plaza de España, to Casa De Pilatos.  She was super knowledgeable and able to speak to everyone in the group.  Would recommend the tour and our guide to anyone wanting to learn the rich history of Seville.
author: christopherkill

title: Private walking tour with Casa de los Pilatos
text: We were blown away by our tour with Pamen. She was accommodating, knowledgeable, kind, generous, and super engaged with us. What an amazing experience! After two tours with LivTours I’m hooked! I will tell everyone I know to book a tour with LivTours. Thank you so much, Pamen, for such an incredible day!
author: stephanie a

title: Walking Seville with Fatima and LIV Tours
text: We had a great day learning about Sevilla with Fatima. She really taught us about the culture and community in Sevilla, and the history behind it. We were fortunate to spend the day with her.
author: Connector604094

title: Great tour - informative and fun
text: The tour was great - interesting and fun. We visited places we would not have seen which were fabulous. We really enjoyed it!
author: fionagD2620BL

title: Immersive day in Seville.
text:
We enjoyed a full day private walking tour “Highlights of Seville”. Our guide, Pamen, was both knowledgeable and entertaining. She was able to keep our three children engaged for a full day and we enjoyed her anecdotes which made the tour seem more personal. 
We thoroughly recommend this tour. We saw so much more of Seville over the day than we expected.

title: Highly suggest
text: Reme was great. She was very friendly. Sweet and informative. Highly suggest the private tour. The pace was perfect.
